name: Infants
agesNote: Questionnaire says 6 weeks to 18 months; Infant/Toddler handbook says 4 weeks to 24 months.
schedule: Each infant follows their own schedule. The day includes napping, eating, diapering, quiet play, and outside time.
summary: A calm, home-like room with cribs, age appropriate toys, and comfortable rocking chairs, where every baby gets individualized attention and plenty of cuddle time.

name: Toddlers
agesNote: Questionnaire says 19 months to 2.5 years; Infant/Toddler handbook says 24 to 36 months.
schedule: A daily routine built around exploration, play, and early language. A daily sheet goes home with changes, meals, and nap times.
summary: A nurturing room where children are encouraged to use their words, and where learning happens through play, projects, and hands-on activities.

name: Room to Bloom
sourceNote: NO SOURCE COPY. This program appears only in the client questionnaire and is described in neither parent handbook. Awaiting a written description from the client.

name: District Pre-K
agesNote: Preschool handbook adds: children must be 3 years of age by October 1.
schedule: Arrival, breakfast, circle time, morning message, read aloud, learning centers, small group, outdoor play, lunch, nap, snack, read aloud, learning centers, dismissal.
summary: A state approved preschool program aligned with the New Jersey Preschool Teaching and Learning Standards, delivered in partnership with Plainfield Public Schools.
bring: Top and bottom crib sheet for the nap mat
Pull-ups and wipes, if not potty trained

name: After 3 Program
